subject.title: [Feature]: Built-in auto-update with configurable schedule, confirmation, and post-update notification

question: Should OpenClaw expand core `update.auto` into a first-class scheduled approval and notification workflow, and which parts belong in core versus Control UI, chat commands, or adjacent update-safety issues?
rationale: The request adds new config and unattended update semantics in a security-sensitive core workflow, so the exact product boundary and approval model should be confirmed before implementation.

options.title: Keep as core workflow tracker
options.body: Use this issue to design the remaining schedule, confirm/notify-only, channel delivery, and post-restart report behavior on the supervised update path.

options.title: Split to narrower follow-ups
options.body: Keep only the engine requirements here and track UI discoverability, chat `/update`, rollback, and plugin updates in their separate issues.

options.title: Reject built-in workflow
options.body: Keep only the current package auto-updater and document cron or agent workflows as operator-owned automation.

recommendation.title: Keep as core workflow tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue to design the remaining schedule, confirm/notify-only, channel delivery, and post-restart report behavior on the supervised update path.

likelyOwner.reason: The current updater schema/runtime/docs and the latest review context route through Peter Steinberger's recent work on this area.
